summary.request: Fixed asset postings need an Asset Project Code so controllers can group acquisition and depreciation costs by investment project. Users enter it on FA journal and FA G/L journal lines and on purchase invoice lines that acquire a fixed asset, and depreciation calculated by the Calculate Depreciation batch must carry the project from the asset's setup. The code must be stored on the FA ledger entries.
summary.business-process: Fixed asset posting: FA journals, FA G/L journals, purchase invoice posting of fixed asset lines and the Calculate Depreciation batch, ending in FA ledger entries.

knowledge.used-for: Purchase invoice fixed asset path through Invoice Posting Buffer and depreciation path through Calculate Depreciation.
constraints: A purchase line field must be put into Invoice Posting Buffer, including its grouping key when values may differ per line.

knowledge.used-for: Filling the buffer from the purchase line and keeping lines with different codes in separate groups.
constraints: Subscribe to OnPrepareLineOnAfterFillInvoicePostingBuffer on Purch. Post Invoice Events and leave IsHandled untouched.

knowledge.used-for: Deciding which entries besides the FA ledger entry store the code, and what reversal does to it.

open-questions.question: What does Asset Project Code refer to: an existing table (for example a dimension value or a project), a new Asset Project master table, or free text? This decides the TableRelation and the exact type and length on every table; a new master table would also need its own pages, permissions and setup.
Which record is the asset's setup for depreciation: the Fixed Asset card, or the FA Depreciation Book (so the code can differ per depreciation book)?
Should FA journal, FA G/L journal and purchase invoice lines default the code from the asset when the FA No. is entered, or is it entered manually only?

Should the code be editable on purchase lines of other types, and on purchase orders and credit memos, or only on invoice lines of type Fixed Asset? Credit memos and orders post through the same buffer path.
The mirroring guidance adds the field to Purch. Rcpt. Line, Purch. Cr. Memo Line, Return Shipment Line and Purchase Line Archive unless excluded. Are any of these not needed?
Are maintenance postings in scope? If so, Maintenance Ledger Entry also needs the field and both copy events of Make Maintenance Ledger Entry.
Do controllers also need the code on G/L entries, or only on FA ledger entries? The request names only FA ledger entries, so G/L Entry is not extended.

Is a stored FA Ledger Entry field required for list grouping, or is a related table keyed by Entry No. acceptable? The request says stored; the performance guidance prefers a related table for sparse attributes.
Where will controllers group the costs: a column on the FA Ledger Entries page, a report, or an analysis view? No page or report is designed for this yet.
Should FA ledger entries posted before installation get a value, or stay blank?
Must reversed FA transactions keep the original code on the reversing FA ledger entries? Confirm the expected behavior with a reversal test.
Which Business Central version does the app target? It decides whether tooltips can be inherited from table fields (runtime 13.0, BC24) or must be declared on each page.
